list.title: Workspaces
list.description: The top level of data: modules arrange their content by workspace.
list.empty_hint: Create the first one — zones and tasks will appear in it.

delete.title: Delete workspace
delete.empty: The workspace is empty. Delete it?
delete.with_content: It contains {content}. The content stays in place and comes back with the workspace.
delete.reversible: Deletion can be undone: the workspace goes to the deleted list, where it can be restored.

purge.title: Delete forever
purge.empty: The workspace is empty. The row will be removed from the database for good.
purge.with_content: Everything inside the workspace will be physically removed with it — {content}. It can't be restored.
purge.confirm_hint: To confirm, type the workspace name.

workspace.deleted: The workspace is deleted — restore it first
workspace.not_deleted: The workspace isn't deleted — nothing to restore
